PROVIDERS.NATIVE_DESC: Connect through an unofficial API, pairing as with WhatsApp Web, with no outside provider
PROVIDERS.NATIVE_CONNECTOR_NOT_RUNNING: The WhatsApp connector is not running on this installation, so a native inbox cannot be created now. Whoever runs the server can see why on the Super Admin health page.
PROVIDERS.UAZAPI_DESC: Connect through the unofficial Uazapi API, on your own instance

PROVIDER_URL.LABEL: Provider URL
PROVIDER_URL.PLACEHOLDER: If provider is not running locally, please provide the URL

CLIENT_TOKEN.LABEL: Security Token
CLIENT_TOKEN.PLACEHOLDER: Please enter your Security Token (see Security tab on Z-API dashboard)

EXTERNAL_PROVIDER.SUBTITLE: Click below to setup the WhatsApp channel.

LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.TITLE: Link your device
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.SUBTITLE: Link your device to this inbox. Make sure the phone number is correct before you start.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.PAIRING_CODE_STEP_1: On the phone that will answer, open WhatsApp.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.PAIRING_CODE_STEP_2: Go to Linked devices and tap Link a device.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.PAIRING_CODE_STEP_3: Tap "Link with phone number instead" and type the code above.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.PAIRING_CODE_EXPIRES: The code is good for a few minutes. Ask for another one if it expires.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.CONNECTED: Your device has been connected successfully. You can now start sending and receiving messages.
LINK_DEVICE_MODAL.IMPORT_SESSION_DESC: WhatsApp now requires a passkey when linking some accounts, which blocks the QR code. Install the browser extension to import a session you're already logged into on WhatsApp Web.

BASE_URL.LABEL: Instance URL
BASE_URL.ERROR: Enter the address of your instance

TOKEN.LABEL: Instance token
TOKEN.PLACEHOLDER: Paste the token of the instance you want to use

MARK_AS_READ.LABEL: Mark messages as read on WhatsApp
MARK_AS_READ.DESCRIPTION: Replying from Chatwoot also marks the conversation read on the phone.

PRESENCE_SUBSCRIBE.LABEL: Show when the contact is online
PRESENCE_SUBSCRIBE.DESCRIPTION: Shows “typing…” and “recording…” in the conversation while the contact is writing.

HISTORY_SYNC.LABEL: Import older conversations when pairing
HISTORY_SYNC.DESCRIPTION: Brings in the history the phone offers at pairing, all of it as resolved conversations. Messages received while the connection was down are recovered either way.

PROXY_URL.LABEL: Proxy (optional)
PROXY_URL.DESCRIPTION: WhatsApp for this inbox goes out through this address. Leave it empty to connect directly.
PROXY_URL.ERROR: Use an http, https or socks5 address with a host

HISTORY_MEDIA.TITLE: Files from the imported history
HISTORY_MEDIA.DESCRIPTION: Imported history arrives without its files. With this on, images, audio and documents are downloaded in the background after the import, newest first, as long as WhatsApp still has them. Older files can be downloaded from the conversation.
HISTORY_MEDIA.DAYS_ERROR: Enter a whole number of days greater than zero.

LEGACY_PROVIDER.BADGE_DESCRIPTION: This provider still works, and receives no new features.
LEGACY_PROVIDER.NOTICE: This provider is legacy. It still works.
LEGACY_PROVIDER.NOTICE_WITH_NATIVE: This provider is legacy. It still works, but we recommend WhatsApp (native) instead.

APP_SECRET.LABEL: App Secret
APP_SECRET.PLACEHOLDER: Paste your Meta app's App Secret
APP_SECRET.HELP: In your app on developers.facebook.com, open App settings > Basic and copy the App secret. It confirms that each webhook really comes from Meta.

CONFIRM.TITLE: Convert inbox provider
CONFIRM.INTRO: You are about to change the WhatsApp provider for '{inboxName}' (currently {currentProvider}). Before continuing, review what will happen:
CONFIRM.EFFECT_DISCONNECT: The current session with {currentProvider} will be disconnected.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_TEMPLATES: Message templates will be cleared and must be resynced on the new provider.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_CONNECTION: Provider connection state will be reset.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_PRESERVED: Conversations, messages, contacts, agent assignments and history are preserved.
CONFIRM.EFFECT_IDENTITY: Inbox name and phone number stay the same.
CONFIRM.CONFIRM_PROMPT: To confirm, type the inbox name below:

API.ERROR_MESSAGE: Could not convert inbox. Please check the credentials and try again.

SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_MANAGE_PROVIDER_CONNECTION_SUBH: Link your device and manage the provider connection.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_PROVIDER_URL_SUBHEADER: If the provider is not running locally, please provide the URL.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_MARK_AS_READ_SUBHEADER: If turned off, when a message is viewed in Chatwoot, a read receipt will not be sent to the sender. Your messages will still be able to receive read receipts from the sender.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_PRESENCE_SUBSCRIBE_SUBHEADER: When enabled, you will see typing indicators in the conversation when a WhatsApp contact is typing or recording audio. Requires reconnecting the channel to take effect.
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_INSTANCE_ID_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new Instance ID here
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_TOKEN_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new instance Token here
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_CLIENT_TOKEN_SUBHEADER: Your Z-API Client Token (see Security tab on Z-API dashboard).
SETTINGS_POPUP.WHATSAPP_CLIENT_TOKEN_UPDATE_SUBHEADER: Enter the new Security Token here

WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.TITLE: App Secret
WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.HELP: The secret of the Meta app that issued this inbox's access token. It confirms that each webhook really comes from Meta.
WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.MISSING: This inbox has no App Secret, so its webhooks are accepted without checking that they come from Meta. A future version will refuse them: add the App Secret to keep receiving messages.
WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET.ERROR: Could not save the App Secret. Check that it belongs to the same Meta app that issued this inbox's access token.

ZAPI_WEBHOOK_URL.TITLE: Receiving address
ZAPI_WEBHOOK_URL.HELP: Z-API delivers this inbox's messages to an address with a key of its own. If that address shows up where it should not, such as a log or a support ticket, generate a new one: Z-API switches to it and the old one stops working.
ZAPI_WEBHOOK_URL.ERROR: Z-API did not accept the new address. The inbox keeps receiving on the current one; try again.

WHATSAPP_DISCONNECTED.MESSAGE: This WhatsApp is not connected, so the inbox cannot send or receive messages. Connect the phone to pair it again.

ASSIGNMENT.PREVENT_TAKEOVER_SUB_TEXT: Once an agent takes a conversation, only they or an administrator can change who is handling it. Automatic assignment is not affected.

REOPEN_TEAM.TITLE: Keep the assignee on reopen only if they are in the conversation's team
REOPEN_TEAM.DESCRIPTION: When a customer's message reopens a resolved or snoozed conversation that has a team, the assignee keeps it only if they are a member of that team. Otherwise the conversation goes to Unassigned, keeping its team and labels.

REOPEN_OWNER.TITLE: When the customer writes to a conversation a person resolved
REOPEN_OWNER.DESCRIPTION: Applies to inboxes with an active agent bot. Sets who owns the conversation when the customer's message reopens it.

OPTIONS.AGENT_BOT: Hand it to the agent bot
OPTIONS.ASSIGNEE_WITHIN_WINDOW: Keep it with the person if the customer writes within a number of hours

REOPEN_OWNER.HOURS_HELP: After that, the conversation goes to the agent bot.
REOPEN_OWNER.HOURS_ERROR: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to 8760.

EXISTING_TEMPLATE.LABEL: Select template
EXISTING_TEMPLATE.EMPTY_STATE: No compatible templates found. Templates must have a URL button with a dynamic parameter.
EXISTING_TEMPLATE.SYNC_ERROR: Failed to sync templates. Please try again.

TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.TITLE: Template variables
TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.DESCRIPTION: Set values for the template body variables. You can use dynamic variables like {'{{'} contact.name {'}}'} that will be resolved at send time.
TEMPLATE_VARIABLES.VALIDATION_ERROR: Please set all template variables before saving.

WEBHOOK.REGISTER_SUCCESS_WITHOUT_ROUTING: Webhook registered, but Meta did not confirm pointing this number itself here. Check the card below for where delivery goes now.
WEBHOOK.RIDES_ON_APP_CALLBACK: Delivery follows the app callback URL: neither this number nor its WhatsApp Business Account is pointed at this installation, so it stops arriving if that URL changes.
WEBHOOK.APP_CALLBACK_POINTS_ELSEWHERE: This number has no routing of its own, so delivery follows the app callback URL shown below, which is not the one expected for this number. Registering the webhook points this number here; if Meta refuses that for this account, the app callback is what has to change.

CONVERSATION_CONTINUITY.TITLE: Conversation continuity
CONVERSATION_CONTINUITY.NOTE_TEXT: Decides where a new email lands when it does not reply to an existing thread. A reply always stays in the thread it answers, whatever this setting says.
CONVERSATION_CONTINUITY.TOGGLE_HELP: When a contact writes a fresh email while one of their conversations is still open, the message joins that conversation instead of starting another one. Once the conversation is resolved, the next email opens a new one. Leave this off to keep one conversation per email thread.

BUSINESS_HOURS.RESTRICT_ASSIGNMENT: Only assign conversations during business hours
BUSINESS_HOURS.RESTRICT_ASSIGNMENT_HELP: Outside the hours above, agents cannot assign this inbox's conversations, to themselves or to anyone else, and automatic assignment does not hand them out. With assignment V2, what arrived while closed is handed out once the inbox opens. Administrators can still assign at any time.
